description: This file is a jQuery adapter for CKEditor, providing integration and extending jQuery with CKEditor-specific methods such as ckeditor() and ckeditorGet(), as well as overriding the val() method for textareas with CKEditor instances.

methods.name: ckeditor
methods.description: Initializes CKEditor on selected elements, either inline or replacing textareas, with support for callbacks and event handling.

methods.name: ckeditorGet
methods.description: Retrieves the CKEditor instance associated with the first selected element.
